lt1_final_overview.readiness.note: States Funding Readiness comes before Ready to Fund; the 'resolved ownership' step is in lt1_partner_flow.
lt1_final_overview.readiness.text: Funding Readiness then validates destination, ownership, consent freshness, and final evidence. Passing Final Underwriting is not Ready to Fund until Funding Readiness is complete.

lt1_ownership.rule.text: Funding Account Ownership: an unrelated account holder enters Specialist Review; a name-format-only mismatch with matching account and routing tokens remains Evidence Required. Passing or resolving this rule permits movement to remaining Funding Readiness checks and does not mean the application is approved.

nc1_full_flow.pass_path_and_evidence_loo.context: New Customer Full Underwriting Process - Version 1
nc1_full_flow.pass_path_and_evidence_loo.note: Seven contiguous edges: the remaining pass path plus the evidence loop.
nc1_full_flow.pass_path_and_evidence_loo.section: New Customer Full Underwriting Process - Version 1
nc1_full_flow.pass_path_and_evidence_loo.text:
- Rule Result --Pass--> Run Scoring and Affordability
- Scoring and Affordability -> Fraud and Compliance Checks
- Fraud and Compliance --Clear--> Final Verifications
- Final Verifications --Complete--> Ready to Fund
- Rule Result --RFAI--> Evidence or NMI
- Evidence or NMI --resolved--> Evidence Integrity Gate
- Evidence Integrity Gate --valid--> Run Full Underwriting Policy and Credit Checks

nc1_history.audit_fields.text: Each terminal, evidence-request, notice, or manual result retains source data, timestamp, rule code, action, policy version, and reviewer or system identifier.

nc1_identity_exception.footnote_1.text: [1] Blocked SSN exception: the active block may be treated as passed only when it is a resolved administrative duplicate older than 48 months, the current identity comparison is exact, and a clean secondary identity source corroborates the match. This exception permits continuation; it is not approval.

nc1_line_limits.independent_controls.text: The minimum line floor and maximum line cap remain independent controls applied after the matrix cell is selected.

nc1_line_policy.adjustment.text: The selected adjustment is applied only after hard policy rules have passed or been resolved. A positive cell cannot override a decline, compliance stop, unresolved manual review, or missing compatible score band.

nc1_missing_scores.scoring_footnote.text: The narrow scoring footnote can permit continuation when a vector is unavailable and Null Score did not fire. It cannot create a score, assign a line, or guarantee approval. A schema mismatch is distinct from a missing vector and follows Code 141.

nc1_routing_exception.footnote_2.note: Footnotes [2] and [3] sit in one chunk and serve different groups (R-D02/override uses [2], R-D03/schema uses [3]).
nc1_routing_exception.footnote_2.text: [2] Blocked Routing exception: a block caused solely by a temporary network anomaly may be treated as passed only after two clean Intraday Account Review observations at least 24 hours apart and documented supervisor authorization. The original block, both observations, the exception reason, and authorizer must remain in history. Passing this rule does not approve or fund the application.

nc1_routing_exception.footnote_3.text: [3] Scoring continuation exception: if a required score vector is unavailable and the Null Score condition did not trigger, the scoring rule may be treated as passed solely to continue to non-score controls. No score is created. Code 141 applies when a vector exists but belongs to an incompatible score schema; that condition must be resolved rather than numerically approximated.

nc1_skip.skip_reason.text: A later rule may be skipped after an earlier terminal result, but the skip reason must distinguish not applicable from not evaluated.
